name: Crisis Text Line
one_liner: Crisis Text Line provides free 24/7 crisis support via text message, connecting people in crisis with trained counselors.
best_for: People in emotional crisis who prefer texting
Young people who communicate primarily via text
Anyone needing immediate support for overwhelming emotions
not_for: People seeking ongoing therapy or treatment
short_description: Crisis Text Line provides free 24/7 crisis support via text message, connecting people in crisis with trained counselors.
long_description: Crisis Text Line is a free, 24/7 text-based crisis service available to anyone in the US. Text HOME to 741741 to connect with a trained crisis counselor who can help with any emotional crisis—anxiety, depression, suicidal thoughts, abuse, or any overwhelming situation. Conversations are confidential and anonymous. Crisis counselors are volunteers who complete extensive training in crisis intervention. This is not ongoing therapy but immediate support for people in distress. Crisis Text Line has handled millions of conversations since 2013 and is a vital resource for those who prefer texting to calling.

pricing.notes: Completely free crisis text service. Text HOME to 741741.

privacy.notes: Crisis service with strong privacy protections. Anonymous support available.

faqs.q: How do I reach Crisis Text Line?
faqs.a: Text HOME to 741741 from anywhere in the US to connect with a trained crisis counselor. Conversations are free, confidential, and available 24/7.

Trained volunteer crisis counselors answer texts. They complete 30+ hours of training in crisis intervention and are supervised by mental health professionals. They're there to listen and help you through difficult moments.
Yes, conversations are confidential and you don't need to share identifying information. The only exception is if there's imminent risk to life, where counselors follow safety protocols.

faqs.q: What qualifies as a crisis for Crisis Text Line?
faqs.a: Any overwhelming emotional distress—anxiety, depression, suicidal thoughts, relationship issues, abuse, grief. You don't need to be suicidal to reach out. If you're struggling emotionally, Crisis Text Line is there.
